text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —One afternoon. In Ines Fujin's classroom.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it for today. There are a lot 
more terms to memorize now, so make sure 
to organize them along with the dates!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's over. I used my brain way 
too much~ I'm so sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll sleep... for just 10 minutes...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hellooo?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chaaan in dreamland? We've got a 
short English quiz coming up, are you 
ready for it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was close!?!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, crap... that was close... saved me 
there...! Thanks, Ines...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're welcome? Well, I get why 
you'd be exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Want something to wake you up? A 
choco-mint Toughness Bar. It's a special 
treat, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: B-Big sister...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ines, your singing voice really carries 
well. Do you have some kind of secret 
trick?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, I honed this through my 
part-time jobs... If I had to put it into 
words, it'd be 'reaching far and wide'! 
That's the mindset I keep in mind!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I see... Ahhhhh~ Ahhhhhh~♪

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —*cough*!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
E-Hehehe... I guess I got a little too 
pumped up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mm, messed up? Alright, I'll go buy some 
drinks real quick!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Apple juice and... Miracle-chan, is water 
fine? Oh, I have throat lozenges in my 
bag, so suck on one while you wait~

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hold on just a sec...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, would you have preferred something 
other than an apple?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! ...Jeez, you really don't 
have to go that far for me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you naturally turn into a "big 
sister," don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Our next classroom change is... the 
science room! Ryan-chan is there, and 
Helios-chan is there too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft! Ahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Ines! Checking in such a natural 
way...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally! Let's all go holding hands☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wanna hold hands, Big Sis? I'm totally 
down! Here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eeeh? Fufu... No, I'm sorry, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahaha! Man, being a big sister 
really is second nature to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't everyone in our class, including 
the homeroom teacher, think the exact same 
thing? 'Ines is basically our big 
sister.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, ahaha! No way that's... actually, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It just happens, you know? I know I 
shouldn't, but... I just can't stop 
myself~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I 
happened to witness the whole incident—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her natural 'big sister disposition' kicks 
in even with her classmates. Just watching 
it is heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hello-hello~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you staring at?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking I'm glad it's such a 
fun class.
Big sis is in top form again today!

Big sis is in top form again today, isn't 
she!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you staring at?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking I'm glad it's such a 
fun class.
Big sis is in top form again today!

Big sis is in top form again today, isn't 
she!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You can tell? Bingo! They're all such 
good, dependable kids...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: She's my precious friend!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, were you just about to tease me? 
That's not very nice, is it~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's true though!
